# Missing Data Sensitivity

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
library(mice)
library(broom.mixed)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Data Setup
```{r}
controls <- c(
  "wave", "is_weekend",
  "baseline_Age", "baseline_Gender", "baseline_Race",
  "baseline_EdLevel", "baseline_Income",
  "Relationship", "Tenure", "Usage", "Social", "Productivity"
)

design_vars <- c("date_since_start", "is_weekend")


re_pid  <- "(1 | pid)"
lmer_ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))

# Waves used in the analysis models.
timepoints <- c("baseline", "diary1", "midline", "diary2", "endline")


aux_timepoints <- c(timepoints, "post")

baseline_covs <- c("Age", "Gender", "EdLevel", "Income", "Race")
other_covs    <- c("Tenure", "Usage", "Social", "Productivity", "Relationship", "baseline_intensity", "baseline_problematic_use")


baseline_stats_for <- function(vars, data = df) {
  out <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
    col <- paste0("baseline_", v)
    if (!col %in% names(data) || !is.numeric(data[[col]])) {
      return(c(mean = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, n = 0))
    }
    x <- data[[col]]
    c(mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(x)))
  })
  names(out) <- vars
  out
}

standardize_to_baseline <- function(d, vars, stats, also_prefixed = character()) {
  missing_stats <- setdiff(vars, names(stats))
  if (length(missing_stats) > 0) {
    stop("no baseline constants for: ", paste(missing_stats, collapse = ", "))
  }
  for (v in vars) {
    s  <- stats[[v]][["sd"]]
    mu <- stats[[v]][["mean"]]
    if (is.na(s) || s == 0) next        # no usable baseline -> leave in raw units
    if (v %in% names(d) && is.numeric(d[[v]])) {
      d[[v]] <- as.vector((d[[v]] - mu) / s)
    }
    for (p in also_prefixed) {
      pc <- paste0(p, v)
      if (pc %in% names(d) && is.numeric(d[[pc]])) {
        d[[pc]] <- as.vector((d[[pc]] - mu) / s)
      }
    }
  }
  d
}

```

```{r}
DATA_DIR <- "../data/"
df <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "participant_data.csv"), check.names = TRUE)
long_df <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "participant_data_long.csv"), check.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Collapse the sparse demographic levels that would otherwise be singleton cells.
collapse_levels <- function(x, other, other_label = "Other") {
  x <- as.character(x)
  factor(ifelse(x %in% other, other_label, x))
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_treatment = ifelse(baseline_treatment == "True", 1, 0),
    wave      = factor(wave),
    baseline_Gender = collapse_levels(baseline_Gender, c("2", "4")),
    baseline_Race   = collapse_levels(baseline_Race,   c("3", "4", "5", "6", "7")),
    Relationship = factor(
      case_when(
        baseline_Relationship == 0                ~ "Single",
        baseline_Relationship %in% c(1, 2, 3)     ~ "In Relationship",
        baseline_Relationship %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7)  ~ "Other",
        TRUE                                      ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("Single", "In Relationship", "Other")
    )
  )

dvs <- unique(c(
  "loneliness", 
  "wb", 
  "esi", 
  "BPNSFS_Autonomy",   
  "BPNSFS_Competence",
  "BPNSFS_Relatedness", 
  "lubben", "social_satisfaction", "ppl_met_inperson",
  "problematic_use", 
  "is_weekend", "date_since_start"
))

# Every wave from randomization through the end of the deactivation window.
# The post-resumption wave lives in "Post Analyses.qmd", not here.
timepoints    <- c("baseline", "diary1", "midline", "diary2", "endline")
baseline_covs <- c("Age", "Gender", "EdLevel", "Income", "Race")
other_covs    <- c("Tenure", "Usage", "Social", "Productivity", "Relationship", "Novelty", "Entertainment", "isProductivityMain", "isSocialMain")

sd_table <- function(stats) {
  data.frame(
    outcome       = names(stats),
    baseline_mean = vapply(stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "mean"),
    baseline_sd   = vapply(stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "sd"),
    n_baseline    = vapply(stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "n"),
    row.names     = NULL
  )
}

# Rescale `vars` in `data` using `stats`, the moments of the pre-deactivation rows.
rescale_to_baseline <- function(data, vars, stats) {
  for (v in vars) {
    s <- stats[[v]]["sd"]
    if (is.na(s) || s == 0) next        # no usable baseline -> leave in raw units
    data[[v]] <- as.vector((data[[v]] - stats[[v]]["mean"]) / s)
  }
  data
}
```

```{r}
person_covs <- c("wave", "baseline_Age", "baseline_Gender", "baseline_Race",
                 "baseline_EdLevel", "baseline_Income", "Relationship",
                 "Tenure", "Usage", "Social", "Productivity")

controls        <- paste(c(person_covs, "is_weekend"), collapse = " + ")

re_pid  <- "(1 | pid)"

lmer_ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))

fit_primary <- function(dv, data = complete_z) {
  lmer(reformulate(c("treatment * isDeactivation", controls, re_pid), response = dv),
       data = data, control = lmer_ctrl)
}
```


## Complete Case Analysis
### Primary Outcomes
```{r}
z_vars <- setdiff(dvs, c("date_since_start", "is_weekend"))

baseline_moments <- function(x) {
  c(mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(x)))
}

long_stats <- lapply(z_vars, function(v) baseline_moments(long_df[[v]][long_df$time == "baseline"]))
names(long_stats) <- z_vars

long_z <- rescale_to_baseline(long_df, z_vars, long_stats)

# Reference table: what "1 SD" means for each outcome.
sd_table(long_stats)
```

## MICE
```{r}
# Intention-to-treat: every randomized participant is imputed, including those
# with no follow-up data.
df_mi <- df
cat("MI sample:", nrow(df_mi), "of", nrow(df), "participants\n")
```

```{r}
mi_dvs <- c("loneliness", "lubben", "social_satisfaction", 
            "ppl_met_inperson", "wb", "esi",
            "BPNSFS_Autonomy", "BPNSFS_Competence", "BPNSFS_Relatedness")

mi_dv_cols <- unlist(lapply(timepoints, function(tp) paste0(tp, "_", mi_dvs)))
mi_dv_cols <- intersect(mi_dv_cols, names(df_mi))

# is_weekend is a model covariate and is missing exactly when a visit was skipped,
# so it has to be imputed too; otherwise lmer drops every imputed row.
mi_design_cols <- paste0(timepoints, "_is_weekend")

mi_numeric_covs <- c("baseline_treatment", "wave",
                     "Tenure", "Usage", "Social", "Productivity",
                     "baseline_intensity", "baseline_problematic_use",
                     "baseline_Age", "baseline_EdLevel", "baseline_Income")
mi_factor_covs  <- c("baseline_Gender", "baseline_Race", "baseline_Relationship")

imp_data <- df_mi %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    baseline_treatment,                                    # 0/1, fully observed
    wave               = as.numeric(as.character(wave)),
    across(all_of(setdiff(mi_numeric_covs, c("baseline_treatment", "wave")))),
    across(all_of(mi_factor_covs), factor),                # mice dummy-codes these
    across(all_of(mi_dv_cols)),
    across(all_of(mi_design_cols))
  )

# Midline always fell on a weekday (every observed value is 0), so a skipped midline
# would have too. mice skips constant columns, so fill it directly.
stopifnot(all(imp_data$midline_is_weekend == 0, na.rm = TRUE))
imp_data$midline_is_weekend[is.na(imp_data$midline_is_weekend)] <- 0

cat("imputation frame:", nrow(imp_data), "rows x", ncol(imp_data), "columns\n")
cat("columns with missing values:", sum(colSums(is.na(imp_data)) > 0), "\n")
```

```{r}
dry <- mice(imp_data, maxit = 0, printFlag = FALSE)

meth <- dry$method              # pmm for every incomplete column
pred <- dry$predictorMatrix
pred[, "pid"] <- 0

table(meth[colSums(is.na(imp_data)) > 0])
```

```{r}
M_IMP      <- 5     # number of imputed datasets
MAXIT_IMP  <- 20    # iterations of the chained-equation loop
SEED_IMP   <- 55
PMM_DONORS <- 5     # candidate donors per missing value
IMP_PATH   <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "mice_imp.rds")

run_mice <- function() {
  mice(
    imp_data,
    m               = M_IMP,
    maxit           = MAXIT_IMP,
    method          = meth,
    predictorMatrix = pred,
    donors          = PMM_DONORS,
    seed            = SEED_IMP,
    printFlag       = FALSE
  )
}

# Reuse the cached imputation only if it was built from exactly this imputation frame.
imp_matches_frame <- function(imp) {
  if (is.null(imp) || imp$m != M_IMP) return(FALSE)
  if (!identical(names(imp$data), names(imp_data))) return(FALSE)
  cached  <- imp$data[order(imp$data$pid), ]
  current <- imp_data[order(imp_data$pid), ]
  isTRUE(all.equal(cached, current, check.attributes = FALSE))
}

imp <- if (file.exists(IMP_PATH)) readRDS(IMP_PATH) else NULL
if (!imp_matches_frame(imp)) {
  message("Cached imputation is missing or stale; re-running mice (this takes a while).")
  imp <- run_mice()
  saveRDS(imp, IMP_PATH)
}
```

```{r}
person_covs <- df_mi %>%
  dplyr::select(pid, Relationship, baseline_Gender, baseline_Race)

mi_long_cols <- c(mi_dv_cols, mi_design_cols)

imputed_long <- complete(imp, action = "long") %>%            # adds .imp and .id
  dplyr::select(.imp, pid, baseline_treatment, wave,
                Tenure, Usage, Social, Productivity,
                baseline_Age, baseline_EdLevel, baseline_Income,
                all_of(mi_long_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(mi_long_cols),
               names_to      = c("time", ".value"),
               names_pattern = paste0("^(", paste(timepoints, collapse = "|"), ")_(.*)$")) %>%
  left_join(person_covs, by = "pid") %>%
  mutate(
    treatment      = baseline_treatment == 1,
    isDeactivation = time != "baseline",
    time           = factor(time, levels = timepoints),
    wave           = factor(wave)
  ) %>%
  arrange(.imp, pid, time)

# Every imputation has every participant at every wave
stopifnot(all(table(imputed_long$.imp) == nrow(df_mi) * length(timepoints)))

head(imputed_long)
```
```{r}
baseline_stats_mi <- baseline_stats_for(mi_dvs, data = df_mi)
imputed_long_z    <- standardize_to_baseline(imputed_long, mi_dvs, baseline_stats_mi)
```

```{r}
fit_and_pool <- function(dv) {
  fits <- lapply(split(imputed_long_z, imputed_long_z$.imp), function(d) {
    fit <- lmer(reformulate(c("treatment * isDeactivation", controls, re_pid), response = dv),
                data = d, control = lmer_ctrl)
    # Only structurally unmeasured outcome rows (e.g. lubben at diary waves) may be
    # dropped; every imputed row must reach the model.
    stopifnot(nobs(fit) == sum(!is.na(d[[dv]])))
    fit
  })
  pool(as.mira(fits))     # Rubin's rules, Barnard-Rubin df
}

interaction_row <- function(pooled, dv) {
  s <- summary(pooled, conf.int = TRUE)
  is_term <- grepl("treatment.*:isDeactivation", s$term)
  stopifnot(sum(is_term) == 1)

  s[is_term, ] %>%
    transmute(outcome = dv, estimate, std.error,
              conf.low = `2.5 %`, conf.high = `97.5 %`, p.value, df) %>%
    bind_cols(pooled$pooled[is_term, c("ubar", "b", "riv", "fmi")]) %>%
    as_tibble()
}
```

```{r}
analysis_dvs <- c("esi", "wb", "loneliness", "BPNSFS_Competence",
                  "BPNSFS_Relatedness", "BPNSFS_Autonomy",
                  "lubben", "ppl_met_inperson", "social_satisfaction")

pooled_by_dv <- setNames(lapply(analysis_dvs, fit_and_pool), analysis_dvs)

pooled_results <- bind_rows(lapply(analysis_dvs, function(dv) {
  interaction_row(pooled_by_dv[[dv]], dv)
}))

pooled_results %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
```

```{r}
outcome_labels <- c(
  esi = "ESI", wb = "WB", loneliness = "Loneliness",
  BPNSFS_Competence = "Competence", BPNSFS_Relatedness = "Relatedness",
  BPNSFS_Autonomy = "Autonomy", lubben = "Lubben",
  ppl_met_inperson = "Ppl In Person", social_satisfaction = "Social Sat."
)

forest_df <- pooled_results %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = rev(analysis_dvs),
                     labels = rev(outcome_labels[analysis_dvs])),
    label   = sprintf("β = %.3f, [%.3f, %.3f], p = %.2f",
                      estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
  )

# Labels sit in a column just right of the data, outside the plotted range
label_x <- max(forest_df$conf.high) + 0.02

ggplot(forest_df, aes(x = estimate, y = outcome)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), width = 0, linewidth = 0.7,
                orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = label_x, label = label), hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = "grey25") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = range(c(forest_df$conf.low, forest_df$conf.high, 0)), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Treatment × deactivation-period interaction estimate", y = NULL,
       title = "Pooled interaction effects across imputed datasets") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 220, 5.5, 5.5))
```
